goal: Allow ChatGPT Android to use manager memory through the same production Gateway v2 endpoint without exposing the legacy CRM or full manager tool registries.
preferred_endpoint_strategy: Expose exactly the compact Gateway v2 surface. Discover a manager memory capability lazily and call it with the current schema hash only when no named workflow covers the request.

memory_capabilities_via_raw_gateway.today_context: Read manager context for the day.
